name: Nursing
title: Nursing — BSc Nursing, GNM and ANM
intro: The nursing routes after Class 12: BSc Nursing, GNM and ANM, with registration and career steps.

phases.title: Class 11–12 subjects
phases.summary: PCB with English is required for BSc Nursing.
points: BSc Nursing requires Class 12 PCB and English with at least 45% marks (as notified).
GNM requires Class 12 pass with English; Science is preferred by many institutes.
ANM is open after Class 12 in most states.
Choose PCB in Class 11 if you plan to enter BSc Nursing.

phases.title: Entrance exams and admission
phases.summary: State CETs, NEET-UG or CUET-UG depending on state and institute.
points: Several states use their own nursing entrance or NEET-UG scores.
Central institutions use CUET-UG or their own tests; AIIMS uses a national entrance.
Apply through state counselling or institution portals.
Check that the college is recognised by the Indian Nursing Council.

phases.title: Course structure
phases.summary: Foundation, medical-surgical, community health and midwifery.
points: BSc Nursing (4 years): Anatomy, Physiology, Nutrition, Fundamentals of Nursing, Medical-Surgical Nursing, Child Health, Mental Health, Community Health and Midwifery.
GNM (3.5 years): theory with clinical postings in medical, surgical, obstetric and community settings.
ANM (2 years): community health, maternal and child health and primary care.
Clinical placements are an essential part of every year.

phases.title: Internship and registration
phases.summary: Complete the internship and register with the State Nursing Council.
points: BSc Nursing includes a compulsory internship in the final year.
GNM includes a six-month internship after the three-year course.
Register with your State Nursing Council to work as a nurse.
Registration is mandatory for government and private hospitals.

phases.title: Careers and higher study
phases.summary: Hospital jobs, government exams and PG.
points: Jobs: staff nurse, ICU nurse, community health nurse and nursing officer.
Government exams: AIIMS NORCET, ESIC and state recruitment exams.
Study further: MSc Nursing, post-basic BSc or specialty diplomas.
International routes: NCLEX (USA), IELTS-based routes for the UK and the Gulf.
